solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Wasted deliveries get impounded

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six deliveries, so deliveries in bulk are overs
pent means shut in or penned up, like something impounded

explanation.surface: A cricket complaint: wasted balls bowled get locked away.
explanation.walkthrough: An over in cricket is six balls bowled from one end, a staple crossword source of OVERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Money that has been squandered beyond the budget has been spent to excess, the past participle used adjectivally.

clue.text: Promises husband to tuck into cereal

indicators.note: the husband letter is tucked into the cereal, inside it

parts.note: oats are a cereal

explanation.surface: A husband promises to eat his breakfast cereal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tuck into' suggests eating, but it places H inside OATS.
explanation.definitionFit: Solemn vows sworn before witnesses are promises.

clue.text: Bride more prepared to dress up

indicators.note: the letters are prepared, made ready in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A bride better prepared to put on her finery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prepared' rearranges BRIDEMORE.
explanation.definitionFit: To dress up a story is to embellish it, as stitching decoration does to cloth.

clue.text: Scottish leaders going on and on — or going up and up?

parts.note: the leading letters of the word Scottish, its first two
rambling is talking at tedious length

explanation.surface: Scottish politicians talking endlessly, or perhaps climbing higher.
explanation.definitionFit: Clambering up a rocky slope using hands and feet is climbing, going up and up.

clue.text: English beauty losing heart to person of taste

indicators.note: the beauty word loses its heart, its middle letter

parts.note: a picture is a beauty, as in she is a picture

explanation.surface: An English beauty loses her nerve to a connoisseur.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing heart' drops T, the middle of PICTURE.
explanation.definitionFit: A gourmet with refined taste in food and drink is a connoisseur, a person of taste.

clue.text: Disarming agent hurries to embrace Georgia

indicators.note: the hurries word embraces the Georgia letters, holding them

parts.note: to tear along is to hurry
GA is the US postal code for Georgia

explanation.surface: A secret agent rushes to hug Georgia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disarming' suggests charm, but the agent is a chemical.
explanation.definitionFit: A gas that makes eyes stream incapacitates crowds, a chemical agent that disarms.

clue.text: Many sheep in East Sussex town

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a crossword stand-in for many
ewes are female sheep

explanation.surface: A rural picture: lots of sheep grazing around a Sussex town.
explanation.walkthrough: Lewes is the county town of East Sussex in southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Lewes is a real historic town in the county of East Sussex, so the definition names an example.

clue.text: Charged to have fun

definitions.meaning: carrying an electric current, as a wire can be
to enjoy life to the full

explanation.surface: Someone is charged up, ready to enjoy themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: A wire carrying current is described as such; to enjoy life fully is the verb sense.

clue.text: Tackle leads to success over Switzerland

indicators.note: in a down answer the success word sits over the Switzerland letters

parts.note: a win is a success
CH is the international code for Switzerland

explanation.surface: A sports tackle brings Swiss success.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tackle' sounds like football but means lifting gear.
explanation.definitionFit: Tackle is lifting gear with ropes and pulleys, and a hoist with a drum is part of it.

clue.text: Veronica creates career skillfully

parts.note: to career is to rush along at speed
well means skilfully or competently

explanation.surface: A woman called Veronica builds a skilful career.
explanation.walkthrough: Veronica is a plant genus as well as a name.
explanation.definitionFit: Veronica is the botanical genus of the small blue-flowered plants of that common name.

clue.text: Italian banker and bishop in row

indicators.note: the bishop's letter is placed in the row, sitting inside it

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: An Italian financier and a cleric are having a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'banker' in crosswords is often a river, something that has banks; 'row' looks like a quarrel but is a tier.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tiber is the river flowing through Rome, so it is an Italian thing with banks.

clue.text: Notice leaders in popular church beforehand

indicators.note: the notice and leaders go in the middle of the popular church pair

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
CE is the Church of England
an ad is a notice in a paper
the van is the leading part of an army or movement

explanation.surface: Church leaders put up a notice ahead of time in a well-liked church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaders' is not the first-letters signal here: the van is the front of an army, and 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something ahead of time is doing it before it is needed, an idiomatic synonym.

clue.text: Rogers must design for adverse tidal conditions

indicators.note: the letters must be designed afresh, laid out in a new pattern

explanation.surface: Someone called Rogers is told to plan for bad tides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'design' rearranges ROGERSMUST.
explanation.definitionFit: A rise of seawater driven by a storm floods coasts, a dangerous tidal state.

clue.text: Political party deceived the country

parts.note: C stands for Conservative, a political party
to have someone is to fool them, so deceived is had

explanation.surface: A political party misled the whole nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Chad is a nation in north-central Africa, an example of a country.

clue.text: Lent hat to cricketer

parts.note: Lent is the Christian season of fasting, so a fast
a bowler is a hard round hat

explanation.surface: Someone lent their hat to a cricket player.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lent' looks like the past of lend but is the season.
explanation.definitionFit: A player who bowls the ball at pace is a type of cricketer.

clue.text: To satisfy doctor I'd lunge

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters are altered

explanation.surface: A fencer lunges at a doctor to please them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' rearranges IDLUNGE.
explanation.definitionFit: To gratify a wish or a person is to satisfy them, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Popular young reporter in Oregon gets medical equipment

parts.note: in means popular
a cub is a trainee journalist
at means in, as at home
OR is the US postal code for Oregon

explanation.surface: A popular rookie journalist in Oregon picks up hospital kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A heated enclosure for premature babies is a piece of hospital apparatus.

clue.text: Make one's home outside a US city

indicators.note: the home-making word goes outside the letter a, wrapping it

parts.note: to settle is to make one's home somewhere

explanation.surface: Someone moves to the edge of an American city to live.
explanation.definitionFit: Seattle is a major city in Washington State in the USA.

clue.text: Go off with Chubby? That's a volte-face!

parts.note: milk on the turn has gone off, so to go off is to turn
round means plump or chubby

explanation.surface: Going off with a plump friend is a complete change of mind.
explanation.definitionFit: A complete reversal of opinion or policy is an about-turn.

clue.text: Inveterate Romeo working in elegant environment

indicators.note: the Romeo and working pieces sit in the elegant word
the elegant word is the environment, surrounding the others

parts.note: chic means stylish or elegant
R is Romeo in the NATO phonetic alphabet
on means working, as a machine is on

explanation.surface: A habitual Romeo is employed in a smart setting.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-standing, ingrained habit is chronic, as in a chronic liar.

clue.text: Charlie's beaten and rattled

parts.note: C is Charlie in the NATO phonetic alphabet
lashed means beaten, as with a whip

explanation.surface: Charlie was beaten and left shaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rattled' looks like upset, but it is the clatter sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Objects that clanged or banged together noisily rattled against each other.

clue.text: Accidental standard

definitions.meaning: in music an accidental is a sign changing a note, one of which cancels a sharp or flat
normal, as expected, the ordinary state

explanation.surface: An accidental happening becomes the norm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Accidental' looks like an adjective but is the musical noun.
explanation.definitionFit: The sign restoring a note to its unsharpened, unflattened pitch is a kind of accidental; normal means standard.

clue.text: The French to support requirement for sewers

indicators.note: in a down answer the French word goes below, holding up the requirement

parts.note: a need is a requirement
les is French for the, plural

explanation.surface: The French back what the drains need.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sewers' looks like drains but means things that sew.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharp stitching tools used to sew thread through cloth are literally sewers.

clue.text: Dismiss blackbird?

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: Should a blackbird be sent away?
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'blackbird' as black plus bird.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a bowler dismisses a batsman by hitting the stumps, so dismiss is bowl.

clue.text: Strange dam on the Dee

indicators.note: in a down answer the dam sits on top of the Dee letter

parts.note: a weir is a low dam on a river
dee is the spelt-out name of the letter D

explanation.surface: An odd dam built across the River Dee.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dee is a river in Scotland and Wales, but here it is the letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something odd or uncanny is strange, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Track blood flow

parts.note: race and blood both mean lineage or stock
to course is to flow, as blood courses through veins

explanation.surface: A doctor tracing the flow of blood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Track' looks like a verb but is the noun, a place for horse racing.
explanation.definitionFit: A circuit where horses race is a racing track.

clue.text: Something occurring in the 70s

indicators.note: the answer is found in the decade's written-out name, so its outer letters are shed

parts.note: the 70s are the seventies

explanation.surface: Something that happened during the 1970s.
explanation.walkthrough: Write out 'the 70s' as SEVENTIES; 'in' says the answer lies within it, dropping S at the front and IES at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A happening or occurrence is an event, a direct synonym.

clue.text: A group of people wanting the last word

parts.note: men is a group of people, males

explanation.surface: A crowd of people who want to have the final say.
explanation.definitionFit: Said at the end of a prayer, it is the closing word of worship.

clue.text: Jubilant pal? I'm hurt dreadfully!

indicators.note: dreadfully suggests the letters are badly mangled

explanation.surface: A friend cries out in pain, yet the clue calls it joyous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadfully' rearranges PALIMHURT.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebrating a victory exultantly, as a triumphal procession does, is jubilant.

clue.text: See function for parasite

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see
a use is a function or purpose

explanation.surface: Look at what job a parasite does.
explanation.definitionFit: A louse is a small wingless insect that lives on hosts, an example of a parasite.

clue.text: Scampered around discharge of gas

indicators.note: the scampered word goes around the discharge word

parts.note: to scamper is to run, so scampered is ran
to do a duty is to discharge it

explanation.surface: Someone ran about, then gas was released.
explanation.definitionFit: Radon is a radioactive noble gas, an example of the class.

clue.text: Cast aspersions on circle embarrassed by sex appeal

parts.note: a disc is a circle
red, as in red-faced from shame
it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Slurs are thrown at a circle of friends shamed by someone's allure.
explanation.definitionFit: To undermine someone's reputation by casting doubt is to cast aspersions, a synonym.
